title: Analysing Impact of Regional Weather on PLC-based Data Transmission in Malaysia, and Nigeria.
summary: UPM studies how regional weather affects power-line communications in Malaysia and Nigeria, aiming to support more resilient network decisions.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The project models relationships between weather and power-line data transmission. It has collected data and developed models for Malaysia and Nigeria, while remaining in research and prototyping. Utility infrastructure replacement is described as context, without a demonstrated AI-caused network improvement.
purpose: Explain weather-related transmission problems and guide network planning.
system: Analysing Impact of Regional Weather on PLC-based Data Transmission in Malaysia, and Nigeria.

ratings.reason: The model is in research and prototyping, without a reported improvement in a network service or decision.
More resilient communications are a prospective downstream benefit.
